lines.trans: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday—and Wednesday at three o'clock, the city clerk walks in!
Sit down and drink your hot coffee before you spill it, Etienne.
Look at our whiteboard: three days, three simple tasks.

words.gram: used as a noun in 'en noir et blanc'

lines.trans: Only three tasks?! Yesterday, Room 9 was full of dust and silent keys!
Sunday: wash all the windows and read your aunt's old green guest book.

words.gram: feminine plural, used as a pronoun

lines.trans: Monday: paint the outside shutters soft green and set up twelve chairs.
Tuesday: repair the silent piano key and bake Wednesday's lemon tarts!
When you divide a mountain into three small hills, I can breathe again!

words.gram: subject pronoun, 2nd person, formal (agent to his star)

lines.trans: Where did you put that old green guest book from the attic, Etienne?
Right here under my arm! Wait: where did I put my coffee cup?
In your left hand, Etienne.
Go rest for ten minutes, boss: Claire and Odette will read the book!

lines.trans: See you soon!

meanings.note: Commonly used in France for civil servants and municipal staff (*un agent de la mairie*).

examples.text: L'agent de la mairie vérifie les documents à l'accueil.
examples.trans: The municipal clerk checks the documents at reception.

examples.text: Un agent du service culturel visite la salle demain.
examples.trans: An officer from the cultural department is visiting the hall tomorrow.

meanings.note: aller + infinitive: tu vas l'agacer = you're going to annoy her
Je vais déjeuner.
Imperative used to encourage.

examples.text: Allez, au travail!
examples.trans: Come on, to work!

examples.text: Madame Odette, tout va bien? Vous avez sonné!
examples.trans: Madam Odette, is everything alright? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: No preposition: attendre quelqu'un.
Il vous attend?.

examples.text: Attendez, elle est bleu foncé, exactement comme la vôtre!
examples.trans: Wait, it is dark blue, just like yours!

examples.text: Attendez, cette rue est juste ici dans notre quartier, à cinq minutes!
examples.trans: Wait, that street is right here in our neighbourhood, five minutes away!

examples.text: Attendez. Regardez en bas sur la marche en pierre.
examples.trans: Wait. Look down on the stone step.

meanings.note: à + le contracted: au boulot, au téléphone

examples.text: Je suis au boulot.
examples.trans: I'm at work.

examples.text: Elle est au téléphone.
examples.trans: She's on the phone.

meanings.note: Time: avant mon départ.

examples.text: Dernière réunion avant mon départ.
examples.trans: Last meeting before I leave.

examples.text: Viens avant midi.
examples.trans: Come before noon.

meanings.note: avoir peur = to be afraid, avoir raison = to be right, avoir 40 ans = to be 40

meanings.en: helper verb of the passé composé
meanings.note: J'ai appelé = I called.

meanings.en: il y a = there is, there are
meanings.note: Fixed expression.

examples.text: J'ai un petit loft.
examples.trans: I've got a little loft.

examples.text: Tu as une réunion.
examples.trans: You have a meeting.

meanings.note: À bientôt = see you soon.

examples.text: À bientôt!
examples.trans: See you soon!

examples.text: Il arrive bientôt.
examples.trans: He's arriving soon.

meanings.note: en noir et blanc = in black and white; feminine: blanche

examples.text: Une chemise blanche.
examples.trans: A white shirt.

examples.text: Elle est trop blanche?
examples.trans: She's too white?

examples.text: Voici une nappe blanche propre et deux tasses bleues.
examples.trans: Here is a clean white tablecloth and two blue cups.

related.gloss: in black and white; feminine: blanche

examples.text: Ne bois pas trop!
examples.trans: Don't drink too much!

examples.text: Vous voulez boire quelque chose?
examples.trans: Would you like something to drink?

meanings.note: Le bras droit = the right arm.
être le bras droit de quelqu'un = to be someone's right hand

examples.text: Je deviendrai son bras droit.
examples.trans: I will become his right hand.

examples.text: Il lève le bras.
examples.trans: He raises his arm.

examples.text: Ne baissez pas les bras!
examples.trans: Do not give up!

meanings.note: Un café = an espresso.
The place.

examples.text: comme un café du matin ouvert au quartier?!
examples.trans: like a morning cafe open to the neighbourhood?!

examples.text: Donne-moi le lait d'abord pour la machine à café.
examples.trans: Give me the milk first for the coffee machine.

meanings.note: determiner: ce soir = tonight, cette semaine = this week
pronoun: c'est = it is; tout ce que = all that

examples.text: Je ne peux pas venir ce soir.
examples.trans: I can't come tonight.

examples.text: Il y a vingt-cinq ans? Dans cette même maison?
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago? In that same house?

meanings.note: A chair; an armchair is un fauteuil.

examples.text: Prends une chaise.
examples.trans: Grab a chair.

examples.text: Quatre tables, huit chaises, tout est en place!
examples.trans: Four tables, eight chairs, everything is in place!

examples.text: Oh... oh non. Où est ma chaise? J'ai les jambes qui tremblent.
examples.trans: Oh... oh no. Where is my chair? My legs are shaking.

meanings.note: Une chambre d'hôtel.
Une chambre d'hôtel.

examples.text: Une chambre au Carlton.
examples.trans: A room at the Carlton.

examples.text: Elle est dans sa chambre.
examples.trans: She's in her room.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'hot'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.
Descriptive French adjective meaning 'hot'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Il fait chaud.
examples.trans: It's hot.

examples.text: Un café chaud.
examples.trans: A hot coffee.

examples.text: Il fait chaud. Vous faites quoi?
examples.trans: It's hot. What are you doing?

meanings.note: Au citron = made with lemon.

examples.text: Son grand-père coupait du gâteau tiède au citron avec du sucre glace dessus!
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with icing sugar on top!

examples.text: Oh! Le glaçage jaune au citron! On se battait pour la part du coin chaque vendredi!
examples.trans: Oh! Yellow lemon glaze! We fought over the corner piece every Friday!

examples.text: Six citrons jaunes attendent dans mon panier en ce moment: ma cuisine attendait ce vendredi!
examples.trans: Six yellow lemons are waiting in my basket right now: my kitchen was waiting for this Friday!

meanings.note: Smaller and gentler than *une montagne* ('mountain'); Lyon itself is famous for its two hills (*Fourvière* and *la Croix-Rousse*).

examples.text: On voit les toits rouges depuis le haut de la colline.
examples.trans: You can see the red roofs from the top of the hill.

examples.text: Le sentier monte doucement sur la petite colline verte.
examples.trans: The path climbs gently up the small green hill.

meanings.note: Third-group irregular verb inherited from core Latin roots ('-ere'). Core French verb meaning 'to cook, to bake'.

examples.text: Faire cuire au four.
examples.trans: To bake in the oven.

examples.text: Laisser cuire à feu doux.
examples.trans: Let simmer on low heat.

examples.text: Nadia, combien de brioches à la cannelle et de gâteaux au citron votre four peut cuire chaque matin?
examples.trans: Nadia, how many cinnamon rolls and lemon cakes can your oven bake each morning?

meanings.note: J'étais dans les sous-vêtements.
Dans une heure = in an hour.

examples.text: Dans le cinéma.
examples.trans: In the film business.

examples.text: Il y a vingt-cinq ans? Dans cette même maison?
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago? In that same house?

meanings.note: D' before a vowel.
Also 'some': du sucre.

examples.text: Le film de Kechiche.
examples.trans: The Kechiche film.

examples.text: C'est du sucre.
examples.trans: It's sugar.

meanings.note: le dimanche = on Sundays; dimanche = this Sunday

examples.text: Tu travailles le dimanche?
examples.trans: Do you work on Sundays?

examples.text: À dimanche!
examples.trans: See you Sunday!

meanings.en: to divide, break down into parts
meanings.note: *Diviser X en Y* ('to divide X into Y') is useful for splitting tasks, space, or numbers.

examples.text: Divisons le grand travail en trois petites étapes claires.
examples.trans: Let's divide the big job into three clear little steps.

examples.text: Elle divise la pâte à pain en quatre boules égales.
examples.trans: She divides the bread dough into four equal balls.

meanings.note: pronounced dis alone, di before a consonant, diz before a vowel

examples.text: Moi, c'est Henri. Vous êtes en avance de dix minutes.
examples.trans: I am Henri. You are ten minutes early.

examples.text: Voici votre clé, numéro quatre. Le petit-déjeuner est de sept heures trente à dix heures.
examples.trans: Here is your key, number four. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: Vous pouvez faire l'aller-retour en dix minutes?
examples.trans: Can you run there and back in ten minutes?

meanings.note: Sois douce = be gentle. Descriptive French adjective meaning 'sweet'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Une voix douce.
examples.trans: A soft voice.

examples.text: Et regardez, ce gilet doux en laine est propre et neuf. Essayez-le.
examples.trans: And look, this soft wool cardigan is clean and new. Try it on.

examples.text: Et j'ai deux oreillers doux et un tapis bleu tissé dans la réserve!
examples.trans: And I have two soft pillows and a woven blue rug in the storeroom!

meanings.note: douze heures = twelve o'clock / twelve hours

examples.text: Juste ici! Tout a coûté trente-huit euros, alors voici douze euros de monnaie.
examples.trans: Right here! Everything cost thirty-eight euros, so here is twelve euros in change.

examples.text: Dix, onze, douze. Le compte est bon au centime près, merci!
examples.trans: Ten, eleven, twelve. Exact to the last cent, thank you!

examples.text: Attendez une minute... Numéro douze, Rue des Tilleuls, et deux initiales d'enfance écrites dans le coin!
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Rue des Tilleuls, and two childhood initials written in the corner!

meanings.note: Contraction of de + le. In la cause du décès it connects the cause with the death being discussed.
for things you can't count; de la (feminine)

examples.text: C'est du compost.
examples.trans: It's compost.

examples.text: Je veux du pain.
examples.trans: I want some bread.

en.gloss: in; on; of it; about it; some

meanings.note: Preposition. En retard means late; en vacances means on holiday.
Object pronoun replacing a phrase introduced by de. The English wording depends on the expression: en parler means to talk about it; j'en ai assez means I have had enough.
Object pronoun referring to an unspecified amount or to a quantity named after the action: j'en ai deux means I have two (of them).

examples.text: Je suis en retard.
examples.trans: I'm late.

examples.text: Tu es en vacances?
examples.trans: Are you on holiday?

examples.text: Nous en parlons.
examples.trans: We're talking about it.

meanings.en: to come in, to go in
meanings.note: Passé composé with être.
Polite imperative.

examples.text: Attends vendredi à midi: je veux être au premier rang quand l'homme à la valise entrera!
examples.trans: Wait until Friday at noon: I want a front-row seat when Suitcase Man walks in!

examples.text: Bonsoir! Entrez vite à l'abri de la pluie, monsieur.
examples.trans: Good evening! Come quickly inside out of the rain, sir.

examples.text: Vous deux?! Laissez vos tasses, entrez tout de suite!
examples.trans: Both of you?! Leave your cups, come inside right away!

meanings.note: The t is never pronounced.

examples.text: Et vous?
examples.trans: And you?

examples.text: Et demain?
examples.trans: And tomorrow?

meanings.note: Une force extérieure. Derived with the Romance agent/quality suffix '-eur'/'-euse' (from Latin '-or'/'-tor').

examples.text: La porte extérieure est fermée.
examples.trans: The outside door is closed.

examples.text: L'extérieur est identique, oui! Mais regardez à l'intérieur!
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yes! But look inside!

meanings.note: Ouvrir / fermer la fenêtre. Feminine noun ('la fenêtre', plural 'les fenêtres') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'window'.

examples.text: Regardez, il y a une fenêtre là-haut!
examples.trans: Look, there's a window up there!

examples.text: Elle regarde par la fenêtre.
examples.trans: She looks out the window.

examples.text: Parfait. La fenêtre donne sur la rue ou sur la cour?
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

meanings.note: à gauche = on the left, to the left
La main gauche = the left hand.

examples.text: Tu as regardé en haut à gauche!
examples.trans: You looked up and to the left!

examples.text: Tournez à gauche.
examples.trans: Turn left.

related.gloss: on the left, to the left

meanings.note: Top room under the roof beams.

examples.text: Voici la petite clé en argent pour la porte du grenier au troisième étage.
examples.trans: Here is the small silver key for the third-floor attic door.

examples.text: Donnez-nous quinze minutes et ce grenier sera mieux que la chambre sept!
examples.trans: Give us fifteen minutes and this attic will beat room seven!

examples.text: C'est pour ça que vous écoutiez la rue depuis le grenier hier soir!
examples.trans: That is why you were listening to the street from the attic last night!

meanings.note: Dans une heure = in an hour.
À quatorze heures = at two pm.

examples.text: À onze heures.
examples.trans: At eleven o'clock.

examples.text: Quelle heure est-il? Neuf heures trente-cinq!
examples.trans: What time is it? Nine thirty-five!

meanings.note: Yesterday; hier soir means last night, not yesterday evening in ordinary English.

examples.text: Hier, j'ai vu Line.
examples.trans: Yesterday I saw Line.

examples.text: On a fait quoi hier soir?
examples.trans: What did we do last night?

examples.text: Regardez ce qui est arrivé au portail hier soir.
examples.trans: Look what arrived at the gate last night.

examples.text: C'est sympa ici.
examples.trans: It's nice here.

examples.text: Laissez vos photos ici.
examples.trans: Leave your photos here.

meanings.note: Used both for technical installation and simply setting out chairs and tables (*installer douze chaises*).

examples.text: Installons quatre petites tables près des fenêtres du jardin.
examples.trans: Let's set up four small tables near the garden windows.

examples.text: L'électricien a installé une lampe neuve au plafond.
examples.trans: The electrician installed a new lamp on the ceiling.

related.gloss: to put away, tidy up, store neatly

meanings.note: J' before a vowel.

examples.text: J'ai un loft.
examples.trans: I've got a loft.

examples.text: Je n'ai jamais vu cette boîte en quinze ans!
examples.trans: I have never seen that box in fifteen years!

examples.text: Un jour.
examples.trans: One day.

examples.text: Chaque jour.
examples.trans: Every day.

meanings.note: Adverb: je veux juste.
Adjective.

examples.text: Juste là sur votre front, bien au chaud.
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, safe and sound.

examples.text: Sur la cour, juste au-dessus du vieux tilleul. C'est très calme.
examples.trans: The courtyard, right above the old linden tree. It is very quiet.

examples.text: Juste sous cette arche. Je vais monter la valise bleue pour vous.
examples.trans: Right under this archway. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.en: to wash (windows, dishes, clothes, or hands)
meanings.note: Transitive for objects (laver les vitres); reflexive when washing oneself or part of the body (se laver les mains).

examples.text: Nous allons laver toutes les grandes vitres avant vendredi.
examples.trans: We are going to wash all the tall windowpanes before Friday.

examples.text: Claire lave soigneusement les douze tasses neuves.
examples.trans: Claire carefully washes the twelve new cups.

meanings.note: definite article; l' before a vowel
As a direct-object pronoun: le is masculine, la feminine; both become l' before a vowel sound.

examples.text: Le film est fantastique.
examples.trans: The film is fantastic.

examples.text: La pièce de Koltès.
examples.trans: The Koltès play.

examples.text: Je dois lire le cahier de réservations, mais je ne trouve pas mes lunettes!
examples.trans: I need to read the reservation book, but I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: Je lis le mot: Désolé pour l'erreur. Gardez mon sac bleu jusqu'à vendredi, s'il vous plaît.
examples.trans: Let me read the note: Sorry for the mistake. Please keep my blue bag until Friday.

examples.text: Dix-neuf raisons?! Vous accueillez votre frère ou vous lisez un horaire de train?
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

meanings.note: Masculine un livre means 'a book' (and un livre d'or, literally 'book of gold', is a visitor guestbook); feminine une livre means 'a pound (half a kilo)'.

examples.text: Les clients laissent un petit mot dans le livre d'or de l'hôtel.
examples.trans: Guests leave a short note in the hotel's guestbook.

examples.text: Cette étagère est pleine de vieux livres de cuisine.
examples.trans: This shelf is full of old cookbooks.

meanings.note: Lundi prochain = next Monday.

examples.text: Lundi prochain?
examples.trans: Next Monday?

examples.text: À lundi!
examples.trans: See you on Monday!

examples.text: Oh, c'est la valise jumelle du train de lundi?
examples.trans: Oh, is that the twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.en: a hand, help (un coup de main)

examples.text: Lave-toi les mains.
examples.trans: Wash your hands.

examples.text: Elle a un stylo à la main.
examples.trans: She has a pen in her hand.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la mairie', plural 'les mairies') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'town hall'.

examples.text: On va à la mairie demain.
examples.trans: We are going to town hall tomorrow.

examples.text: Attends, Thibault: tu travailles toujours au service des contrats de la mairie?!
examples.trans: Wait, Thibault: you still work at City Hall's contract office?!

meanings.note: No article for 'on Tuesday': mardi.

examples.text: Deux places pour mardi.
examples.trans: Two tickets for Tuesday.

examples.text: Mardi, j'ai une réunion.
examples.trans: On Tuesday I have a meeting.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le mercredi', plural 'les mercredis') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'day of the week'.

examples.text: La séance de mercredi.
examples.trans: Wednesday's screening.

examples.text: À mercredi prochain.
examples.trans: See you next Wednesday.

examples.text: Attends: et mercredi soir, tu as réservé ici sous ton vrai nom?
examples.trans: Wait: and Wednesday night, you booked in here under your real name?

meanings.note: Place something somewhere. Mettre un pied dans la tombe evokes being close to death.

examples.text: Je mets les documents sur la table.
examples.trans: I put the documents on the table.

examples.text: Mets ces herbes vertes fraîches dessus avant de servir.
examples.trans: Put these fresh green herbs on top before serving.

meanings.note: Cinq minutes = five minutes.

examples.text: Attendez cinq minutes.
examples.trans: Wait five minutes.

examples.text: J'arrive dans une minute.
examples.trans: I'll be there in a minute.

meanings.note: Ma before a feminine noun; mon before a feminine noun beginning with a vowel sound or mute h.

examples.text: Je suis à mon cours.
examples.trans: I'm at my lesson.

examples.text: C'est ma place.
examples.trans: It's my seat.

meanings.note: De montagne describes mountain produce such as miel de montagne ('mountain honey') or fromage de montagne.

examples.text: Ce miel de montagne est récolté à la fin de l'été.
examples.trans: This mountain honey is harvested at the end of summer.

examples.text: On voit le sommet de la montagne par temps clair.
examples.trans: You can see the top of the mountain in clear weather.

meanings.note: Doubles the -t in the feminine: muet (/mɥɛ/) -> muette (/mɥɛt/). Also used for silent letters in French spelling (un e muet, un h muet).

examples.text: Henri a réparé le marteau de la touche muette.
examples.trans: Henri repaired the hammer of the silent piano key.

examples.text: Devant la surprise, Étienne est resté muet pendant dix secondes.
examples.trans: Faced with the surprise, Étienne stood speechless for ten seconds.

meanings.note: Final f sounds like /v/ before ans and heures.
Un gilet neuf, une ampoule neuve.

examples.text: C'est à neuf heures.
examples.trans: It's at nine o'clock.

examples.text: J'ai neuf pages à lire.
examples.trans: I have nine pages to read.

examples.text: Vous pouvez? C'est à neuf heures.
examples.trans: Can you make it? It's at nine o'clock.

meanings.note: Plural nos.

examples.text: Deux de nos acteurs.
examples.trans: Two of our actors.

examples.text: C'est notre agence.
examples.trans: It's our agency.

meanings.note: before the noun; nouvel before a vowel
Un nouveau caprice.

examples.text: C'est la nouvelle assistante.
examples.trans: She's the new assistant.

examples.text: Oh, ça s'ouvre! Merci. Je suis Claire, la nouvelle réceptionniste.
examples.trans: Oh, it opens! Thank you. I am Claire, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: En or means 'made of gold' (and figuratively 'wonderful': un voisin en or); un livre d'or is a guestbook where visitors write memories and compliments.

examples.text: Les voyageurs signent le livre d'or avant leur départ.
examples.trans: Travellers sign the guestbook before they leave.

examples.text: Le cadre doré brille comme de l'or sous la lampe.
examples.trans: The gilded frame shines like gold under the lamp.

meanings.note: Tu vas où?; d'où = from where.

examples.text: Je marche toujours vite le premier jour. Où est l'ordinateur?
examples.trans: I always walk fast on the first day. Where is the computer?

examples.text: Exactement ce qu'il me faut. Où est l'escalier?
examples.trans: Just what I need. Where are the stairs?

examples.text: Où vont les petites cuillères et les serviettes?
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

meanings.note: Feminine: patronne.

examples.text: C'est le patron.
examples.trans: He's the boss.

examples.text: La patronne est là.
examples.trans: The boss (woman) is here.

meanings.note: Irregular: je peins, nous peignons, j'ai peint.

examples.text: Seulement une clé dorée peinte au-dessus de la porte. Montrez cette vanne au vendeur.
examples.trans: Only a painted golden key above the door. Show this valve to the clerk.

examples.text: C'est facile à peindre ensemble.
examples.trans: It is easy to paint together.

meanings.note: Affectionate, a bit condescending.
Un petit cours.

examples.text: J'ai un petit loft.
examples.trans: I've got a little loft.

examples.text: C'est une petite agence.
examples.trans: It's a small agency.

meanings.note: Jouer du piano = to play the piano.

examples.text: Il y a vingt-cinq ans, je donnais des cours de piano près d'ici.
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago, I taught piano lessons near here.

examples.text: Si je connais?! Chaque vendredi pendant six ans, j'ai monté cet escalier en bois pour donner cours de piano!
examples.trans: Do I know it?! Every Friday for six years, I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

examples.text: Un menuisier vivait là avec ses deux petits-fils: l'aîné jouait du piano, et le petit adorait les trains!
examples.trans: A carpenter lived there with his two grandsons: the older boy played piano, and the little one loved trains!

meanings.note: Plein de = full of.

examples.text: Elle est pleine de requins.
examples.trans: It's full of sharks.

examples.text: Le café est plein.
examples.trans: The café is full.

meanings.note: Poser une question.
Poser une question.

examples.text: Pose ton sac ici.
examples.trans: Put your bag here.

examples.text: Je peux poser une question?
examples.trans: Can I ask a question?

meanings.note: Essuyer la poussière = to wipe off the dust.

examples.text: Essuyez la poussière sur la plaque en laiton dessus... attendez, lisez ce numéro!
examples.trans: Wipe the dust off the brass plate on top... wait, read that number!

examples.text: Voici la poussière sur la table.
examples.trans: Here is the dust on the table.

meanings.note: Question word or conjunction.

examples.text: Vous serez là quand?
examples.trans: When will you be here?

examples.text: Quand tu veux.
examples.trans: Whenever you like.

meanings.note: no preposition needed: regarder la photo
A film, the TV.

examples.text: Regarde bien cette photo sur la première page!
examples.trans: Look closely at this photo on the front page!

examples.text: Nous allons regarder les premiers essais cet après-midi.
examples.trans: We are going to watch the first screen tests this afternoon.

meanings.en: to spill (a drink), tip or knock over
meanings.note: Covers both knocking over a cup and spilling the liquid inside (*renverser son café*).

examples.text: Attention à ne pas renverser votre tasse de café sur le carnet!
examples.trans: Careful not to spill your cup of coffee on the notebook!

examples.text: Le vent a presque renversé le petit pot de fleurs.
examples.trans: The wind nearly knocked over the small flowerpot.

meanings.en: to rest; se reposer = to rest oneself
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to rest'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'reposé').

examples.text: Reposez-vous bien, madame. Sonnez si vous avez besoin de quelque chose.
examples.trans: Rest well, madam. Ring if you need anything.

examples.text: Promets-moi de te reposer.
examples.trans: Promise me to rest.

examples.text: Respire calmement.
examples.trans: Breathe calmly.

examples.text: Respirez un grand coup, Étienne.
examples.trans: Take a deep breath, Etienne.

meanings.en: to repair, to fix, to mend

examples.text: J'ai réparé son chemisier préféré.
examples.trans: I fixed her favourite blouse.

examples.text: Il répare sa voiture.
examples.trans: He's fixing his car.

meanings.note: Reflexive verb.
Polite imperative.

examples.text: Asseyez-vous, s'il vous plaît.
examples.trans: Have a seat, please.

examples.text: Assieds-toi là.
examples.trans: Sit there.

examples.text: J'ai seulement vingt ans.
examples.trans: I'm only twenty.

examples.text: Seulement un café.
examples.trans: Just a coffee.

examples.text: C'est simple.
examples.trans: It's simple.

examples.text: Une question simple.
examples.trans: A simple question.

meanings.note: Sous la pluie = in the rain. Core French preposition meaning 'under', linking a noun phrase or infinitive complement to the clause.

examples.text: Le chat dort sous la table.
examples.trans: The cat sleeps under the table.

examples.text: J'avais les mains froides sous le choc!
examples.trans: My hands were cold from the shock!

examples.text: Une chambre sous les toits? Je peux la voir d'abord?
examples.trans: An attic room? May I see it first?

meanings.note: A table or chart, including a spreadsheet when Excel is specified.
A painting, a different sense of the same word.
A board used for displaying or writing on.

examples.text: Un tableau Excel.
examples.trans: A spreadsheet.

examples.text: Un beau tableau.
examples.trans: A beautiful painting.

examples.text: Henri, regardez le tableau des clés derrière nous: un, deux, trois, quatre, cinq, six, sept, huit!
examples.trans: Henri, look at the key board behind us: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight!

meanings.note: Standard word for 'aunt' (informal family nickname: tata or tatie).

examples.text: La tante d'Étienne jouait merveilleusement bien du piano.
examples.trans: Étienne's aunt used to play the piano wonderfully.

examples.text: Ma tante a écrit toutes ses recettes à l'encre bleue.
examples.trans: My aunt wrote all her recipes in blue ink.

meanings.note: Named with au/à la/aux before the filling: une tarte au citron ('a lemon tart'), une tarte aux pommes ('an apple tart').

examples.text: Nadia sort deux belles tartes au citron du four.
examples.trans: Nadia takes two lovely lemon tarts out of the oven.

examples.text: Une part de tarte tiède accompagne parfaitement le thé.
examples.trans: A slice of warm tart goes perfectly with tea.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la tasse', plural 'les tasses') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'drinking cup'.

examples.text: Prends une tasse de café.
examples.trans: Take a cup of coffee.

examples.text: Voici une nappe blanche propre et deux tasses bleues.
examples.trans: Here is a clean white tablecloth and two blue cups.

examples.text: Vous deux?! Laissez vos tasses, entrez tout de suite!
examples.trans: Both of you?! Leave your cups, come inside right away!

touche.gloss: key (of a piano or keyboard), button

meanings.en: key (of a piano, organ, or keyboard)
meanings.note: Keep distinct from une clé (a door lock key or a musical clef symbol on a staff): the physical black and white keys you press on a piano are les touches.

examples.text: Une seule touche du vieux piano reste encore muette.
examples.trans: Only one key on the old piano is still silent.

examples.text: Odette essuie délicatement les quatre-vingt-huit touches.
examples.trans: Odette gently wipes the eighty-eight piano keys.

examples.text: Tout va bien.
examples.trans: Everything is going well.

examples.text: Madame Odette, tout va bien? Vous avez sonné!
examples.trans: Madam Odette, is everything alright? You rang the bell!

examples.text: Trois semaines.
examples.trans: Three weeks.

examples.text: Trois cafés.
examples.trans: Three coffees.

meanings.note: The circumflex *â* (from Old French *tasche*) distinguishes *une tâche* ('a task') from *une tache* ('a stain').

examples.text: Écrivons les trois tâches de la journée sur le tableau blanc.
examples.trans: Let's write the day's three tasks on the whiteboard.

examples.text: Quand chacun prend une tâche simple, tout avance vite.
examples.trans: When everyone takes one simple task, everything moves fast.

meanings.note: indefinite article; des in the plural
Number; l'un = one of them.

examples.text: Et voilà la cloche du portail. Un coup franc.
examples.trans: There goes the gate bell. One firm ring.

examples.text: Voilà un taxi devant le portail à l'instant.
examples.trans: Here comes a taxi in front of the gate right now.

meanings.note: feminine verte
un vin un peu vert

examples.text: La porte est verte.
examples.trans: The door is green.

examples.text: Le vin est encore un peu vert.
examples.trans: The wine is still a little unripe.

meanings.note: before the noun; vieil before a vowel: un vieil ami

examples.text: C'est un vieux film.
examples.trans: It's an old film.

examples.text: Non, seulement mon stylo et trois vieux tickets!
examples.trans: No, only my pen and three old receipts!

meanings.note: Wooden exterior shutters on French windows.

examples.text: Parce que les volets en bois mouillés adoucissent l'écho des pavés...
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo from the cobblestones...

examples.text: Sûrement un avis ennuyeux pour repeindre les volets sur la rue.
examples.trans: Probably a boring notice about repainting the street shutters.

meanings.note: Polite or plural 'you'.

examples.text: Votre nom?
examples.trans: Your name?

examples.text: Laissez vos photos ici.
examples.trans: Leave your photos here.

meanings.note: One person, formal.
Several people.
je vous rappelle = I'll call you back

examples.text: Vous êtes où?
examples.trans: Where are you?

examples.text: Madame Odette, tout va bien? Vous avez sonné!
examples.trans: Madam Odette, is everything alright? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Place: à Paris, à mon cours.
Time: à midi.

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
meanings.note: Contractions.

examples.text: Je suis à Paris.
examples.trans: I'm in Paris.

examples.text: À quatorze heures.
examples.trans: At two pm.

meanings.note: The most common verb.
Ce + est.

examples.text: Je suis à Paris.
examples.trans: I'm in Paris.

examples.text: C'est important.
examples.trans: It's important.
